result.description:
The Client 
Smart Energy Group is a full-service renewable solar energy company servicing Australia wide. They design and install bespoke solar solutions that reduce the energy costs of Australian households and businesses whilst improving Australia's green footprint.
They are seeking an experienced Office Manager to join their team Sydney, NSW.


The Role
The position is responsible for coordinating office personnel, allocating resources,
maintaining operational standards, managing records and reporting systems, and
ensuring effective communication between internal departments. The role also
contributes to workforce planning, process improvement, staff development, and
operational compliance to support business objectives.
This is a full-time position with an annual salary of $80,000 plus superannuation. 

The Responsibilities
•	Contribute to the planning, development and review of office services, procedures and operational standards
•	Establish priorities and service standards for sales administration and scheduling functions
•	Monitor operational workflows and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency
•	Ensure effective coordination between Sales, Operations, Installation and Administration departments
•	Allocate staffing resources, workloads and operational support based on business requirements
•	Coordinate office resources, equipment and systems to support business activities
•	Monitor team capacity and operational demands to ensure service delivery targets are met
•	Assign work tasks and monitor performance of scheduling and administration staff
•	Provide leadership, coaching, training and ongoing support to team members
•	Conduct performance reviews and contribute to performance management processes
•	Assist with recruitment, onboarding and training of new employees
•	Manage office records, operational documentation and reporting systems
•	Ensure accurate maintenance of business records, customer information and sales data
•	Oversee CRM systems, including Salesforce and Field Service Lightning
•	Maintain operational reporting and performance tracking systems
•	Oversee appointment scheduling processes and sales administration activities
•	Coordinate workforce schedules and operational requirements across multiple sales regions
•	Manage planning and logistics for away-trip operations and regional sales activities
•	Liaise with operational departments to align scheduling with installation capacity
•	Liaise with managers, operational teams and other professionals to coordinate business activities
•	Facilitate communication between departments and assist in resolving operational issues
•	Respond to internal stakeholder requests and support continuous business improvement initiatives
•	Ensure office equipment, systems and technology resources are maintained and operational
•	Coordinate system access, software requirements and operational support resources
•	Monitor office supply requirements and administrative resources
•	Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures and operational standards
•	Support adherence to relevant workplace health and safety requirements
•	Ensure business processes comply with privacy legislation and data management requirements
•	Assist with implementing regulatory and organisational compliance initiatives
•	Prepare operational reports and performance metrics for management review
•	Monitor scheduling efficiency, workload distribution and service delivery standards
•	Analyse operational trends and identify opportunities for process improvement
•	Provide recommendations to improve office productivity and operational performance


The Requirements:	
•	Must hold a minimum Degree qualification in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
•	Minimum 3 years of experience in office administration, operations coordination, business support, scheduling or office management roles
•	Minimum 3 years’ experience as an Office Manager or in an office administration management role
•	At least 3 years’ experience coordinating office operations, administrative systems, and business support functions
•	Minimum 3 years’ experience managing records, schedules, correspondence, and operational documentation in a commercial environment
•	At least 3 years’ experience supporting multidisciplinary teams within property, real estate, or customer service environments
•	At least 3 years’ experience using office management systems, Microsoft Office applications, and business administration software
•	Strong knowledge of office administration procedures, workflow coordination, and document management practices
•	Ability to manage competing priorities and maintain operational efficiency in a fast-paced environment
•	Strong organisational, communication, and stakeholder coordination skills
•	Ability to prepare reports, maintain accurate records, and manage confidential information professionally
•	Good understanding of workplace compliance, administrative controls, and customer service standards
•	Ability to work independently and support business operations within structured deadlines
•	High attention to detail and problem-solving capability

  About the company:   

 Our client is a registered NDIS provider, it delivers a broad range of community-based allied health services to individuals of all ages and abilities. The organisation is experiencing continuous growth, with new opportunities emerging regularly. It remains deeply committed to delivering best-practice therapy to its clients while fostering a supportive and motivating environment for its team of therapists.

 As a Speech Pathologist, you will be joining a multidisciplinary team. You will provide evidence-based services to people through multiple service delivery models, including telehealth, community visits and centre-based services. Analyse business processes, workflows, and operational challenges to identify opportunities where Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) can deliver measurable business value and improve efficiency.
Manage cloud hosting infrastructure, application servers, development environments, and deployment platforms to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing AI applications.

Good knowledge on software configuration management systems
Logical thinking and problem-solving skills along with an ability to collaborate.

Experience writing functional and technical documentation.
Act as a source of knowledge on best practice in the implementation of operational software systems.

## Sales and Marketing Manager
## Position Overview
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Sales and Marketing Manager to lead and execute strategic commercial initiatives across our organisation. This role is central to driving revenue growth, brand positioning, and market expansion through the effective management of both sales operations and marketing programmes. The ideal candidate is a confident leader with a proven track record of delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. You will bring a strategic mindset, strong analytical capability, and the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams.
## Key Responsibilities
- Formulate, implement, and continuously refine integrated sales and marketing strategies, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and growth targets
- Develop and oversee advertising, public relations, and promotional campaigns, working collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external agencies to maximise brand impact
- Establish and manage sales territories, customer service standards, and product mix to optimise market coverage and revenue performance
- Direct and coordinate the activities of sales personnel, agents, and distributors to ensure consistent execution of sales methods and commercial objectives
- Set pricing structures, credit arrangements, and discount frameworks in line with market conditions and company profitability targets
- Oversee merchandising methods and distribution policy, ensuring product availability and visibility across all relevant channels
- Monitor and analyse market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to inform strategic decision-making and identify new business opportunities
- Develop and manage the sales and marketing budget, tracking expenditure and return on investment to ensure efficient allocation of resources
- Lead the generation and nurturing of leads across digital and traditional channels, converting pipeline opportunities into long-term client relationships
- Produce regular performance reports and present findings to senior leadership, providing data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and industry stakeholders to support retention and business development
- Recruit, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and professional growth
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline
- Minimum of 5 years' experience in a sales and/or marketing management role, with demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding commercial targets
- Strong understanding of both B2B and B2C sales environments, including pipeline management and customer lifecycle strategies
- Proven experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, content, and traditional media
- Proficiency in CRM platforms and marketing automation tools, with the ability to leverage data for strategic insight
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present to senior stakeholders and external partners
- Demonstrated leadership capability, with experience managing, coaching, and developing sales and marketing teams
- High level of commercial acumen and a customer-centric approach to business development
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within deadlines
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualification such as a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent
- Professional accreditation with the Australian Marketing Institute (AMI) or a recognised industry body
- Experience working within a specific industry relevant to our business, such as retail, technology, professional services, or FMCG
- Familiarity with SEO, SEM, and performance marketing strategies, as well as experience managing digital advertising budgets
- Exposure to international or cross-regional markets, including an understanding of export or distribution networks
- Experience with sales enablement tools, marketing analytics platforms, or enterprise-level CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values innovation, initiative, and professional development
- Access ongoing learning and career progression opportunities, including support for further study, industry certifications, and leadership programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available, supporting a healthy work-life balance
- Benefit from a competitive remuneration package, including performance-based incentives that reward your contribution to the business
- Join a team culture built on trust, inclusivity, and shared purpose, where your ideas are heard and your impact is recognised
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Job Details
-  Occupation: Project Administrator
-  Base Pay: $80,000 - $90,000 + Super
-  Contract Type: Permanent
-  Work Type: Full Time
-  Industry: Height Safety Services
-  Sector: Privately Held Company

About the Role
Safe Height Pty Ltd trading as SAFE MOUNT are a specialist provider of Height Safety Compliance  Solutions across SEQ. Our services include System Design, Installation of Height Safety Systems, Certification and Audit, as well as Harness & PPE Inspection services. Due to continued growth, we are seeking an experienced Project Administrator to support the planning, coordination and administration of multiple concurrent projects and service programs for the existing and new clients. The role requires regular travel along southeast Queensland between various projects with possible interstate trips. This role suits a highly capable, analytically-minded professional — potentially with an engineering, scientific, mining or other complex industrial background — who can quickly learn technical and regulatory frameworks, interpret data and adapt across multiple concurrent, complex projects as per various customers’ requirements. 

Skills
-  Project Coordination
-  Contract Administration
-  Contract Management
-  Project Scheduling
-  Microsoft Excel
-  Project Reporting
-  Contractor Management
-  Stakeholder Management
-  Compliance Management
-  Document Control
-  Change Management
-  Data Analysis
-  Bluebeam Revu 

Skills & Experience
-  Tertiary qualification in a technical, engineering, scientific, project management, business or related discipline.
-  Background in engineering, construction, mining, resources, manufacturing or other complex industrial/technical sectors will be highly regarded.
-  Minimum 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles.
-  Demonstrated experience managing interfaces between clients, contractors, suppliers and technical professionals.
-  Experience coordinating projects involving technical design, site installation works, contractor management and regulatory compliance requirements.
-  Experience in schedule monitoring, progress tracking and project performance reporting.
-  Experience in communication with different levels of stakeholders from site labour to decision makers in the client's procurement team
-  Experience supporting project change management and contract variation processes.
-  Advanced Microsoft Excel skills including reporting, forecasting, data analysis and performance tracking.
-  Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
-  Strong analytical and organisational abilities.
-  Demonstrated ability to rapidly learn, analyse and apply new technical, regulatory and operational information across complex, fast-moving project environments.
-  Reading CAD drawings and liaising with Design Project managers and Development Managers

Main Duties / Responsibilities
-  Coordinate and administer height safety compliance inspection programs, system installation projects, and design services.
-  Develop, maintain and review project schedules, work programs, resource plans and project documentation.
-  Prepare and coordinate tender documentation, service agreements, work orders and contract documentation, ensuring project requirements, pricing, scope changes and approvals are accurately recorded throughout the project lifecycle.
-  Coordinate day-to-day communication and workflow between clients, engineers, contractors, installers, inspectors and suppliers to ensure activities are delivered safely, efficiently and in accordance with project schedules.
-  Monitor project and service delivery performance against contractual requirements, compliance obligations and client expectations.
-  Act as a key point of contact for clients, contractors and suppliers by coordinating responses to project enquiries, facilitating communication between stakeholders and assisting with the timely resolution of operational issues.
-  Maintain accurate electronic project records, inspection reports, certification documentation, drawings, registers and compliance documentation to support project delivery and audit requirements.
-  Compile project performance information from multiple operational sources, analyse trends and prepare management reports covering project progress, productivity, compliance performance and service delivery outcomes.
-  Support project change management processes, including assessment, documentation and tracking of project variations.
-  Monitor contractor activities against agreed schedules, scopes of work and project milestones, identifying delays, quality concerns or scope changes requiring management review.
-  Support procurement and subcontractor coordination activities.
-  Prepare project documentation including client reports, operational summaries, project status updates, meeting papers and internal business documentation to support decision-making.
-  Provide project support to senior management by monitoring project risks, escalating critical issues, coordinating follow-up actions and assisting with implementation of operational decisions.
-  Identify delivery risks, compliance issues and operational constraints that may affect project schedules or client commitments.
-  Coordinate height safety inspection, installation and certification activities to ensure compliance with regulatory and client requirements.
-  Monitor contractor performance and support continuous improvement initiatives across projects and service programs.
Experience
-  To be considered for this role, applicants must demonstrate a minimum of 3 years’ experience in project coordination, project administration, project controls or similar project support roles within engineering, construction, industrial services, infrastructure, compliance or other relevant technical service environments. 

Performance Goals
-  Timely delivery of height safety projects and annual compliance service programs.
-  Effective planning, scheduling and delivery of projects from tender stage to practical completion and handover
-  Accurate and effective project reporting.
-  Efficient coordination of contractors, suppliers and stakeholders.
-  Compliance with contractual, regulatory and client requirements.
-  Continuous improvement of project administration, reporting and coordination processes.

Other Requirements
-  Current, open driver’s licence, with willingness to travel regularly across South East Queensland and occasionally interstate.

How to Apply
Submit a resume and cover letter to info@safemount.com.au or via the application link.
We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, cultural background, disability or other protected attributes.
